summary: Select's option list portals to <body>, which leaves a [data-ui-density] subtree, and Select has no popup part a caller could pass the attribute to. On open it now reads the trigger's nearest [data-ui-density] and sets the same value on its panel (data-slot=select-panel), so a Select inside a compact inspector opens a compact list. With no ancestor attribute nothing is set, so default rendering is unchanged; with density on <body> the value is the one the portal already inherited. No new prop.
